remarks: Here is your opportunity to rent a Raised Ranch at the end of cul-de-sac. Living Room/dining Room with French doors leading to a 4-season sunroom. Updated Kitchen with SS appliances, main floor bath fully updated, 3 bedrooms, primary with ample closet space. Lower level consisting of a large additional family room or flex space with full walkout, additional full bath (shower stall in process of being fully re-done). New Pella slider and windows. 1 car attached garage. The back yard has a small concrete patio, and a vast amount of green space! Back half is fully fenced in for your convenience. Landscaping included in rent.
